causes: Target host is down or unreachable.
Routing issue between source and destination.
troubleshooting: Verify IP address or hostname.
Check if the host is powered on and reachable locally.
Allow ICMP in firewall or test with firewall temporarily disabled.
Test from another network segment.
Run traceroute to identify the failing hop.

causes: Incorrect subnet mask or gateway configuration.
ARP resolution failure in local network.
troubleshooting: Check local IP configuration (ipconfig or ifconfig).
Verify default gateway.
Ensure both devices are in the same subnet for LAN use cases.
Inspect routing table (route print or ip route).
Restart network adapter.
Reset TCP/IP stack.
Disable VPN temporarily.
Reinstall or update NIC driver.

entries.errorName: Unknown Host / Could Not Find Host
troubleshooting: Try pinging an IP instead of hostname.
Validate DNS settings on probe host.
Run nslookup for target domain.
Switch to known resolver (for example 8.8.8.8) for testing.

causes: Packet exceeded hop limit before reaching destination.
troubleshooting: Run traceroute to detect routing loop.
Review routing configuration on intermediate routers.
Escalate to ISP or network team with hop evidence.

causes: Port blocked by firewall or ACL.
troubleshooting: Validate service port and listener status.
Verify firewall rules on source and destination.
Test from another host/network.
Use netcat or nmap to confirm port reachability.

causes: Service is not running on target port.
Application crashed or listener failed to bind.
troubleshooting: Ensure target service is running.
Verify configured host and port.
Restart application or service.
Review application and system logs for bind errors.
Validate hostname and IP.
Ping host first to confirm base reachability.
Check DNS resolution and route path.
Check routing table.
Verify gateway and interface state.
Confirm VLAN/subnet reachability end-to-end.

causes: Service accepted then dropped the connection.
troubleshooting: Inspect server-side logs for disconnect reason.
Verify application keepalive and timeout settings.
Check security appliances for active resets.
Validate certificate chain and SAN/CN.
Confirm TLS protocol and cipher compatibility.
Test endpoint with openssl s_client or browser diagnostics.
